purpose: We will never re-identify patients. There is no third-party access planned. Our study measures treatment gaps in anticoagulation therapy for atrial fibrillation prevention.
question: Count adults with atrial fibrillation by hospital.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Atrial fibrillation = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I48.
Report per hospitals: adults with atrial fibrillation.
